name: Volt Carbon Technologies Inc.
summary: Volt Carbon Technologies Inc. functions as a Canadian enterprise within the junior resource industry, segmenting its activities into two core areas: mineral exploration and development, and dedicated research and development. The company possesses mineral claims for various molybdenum deposits across British Columbia, in addition to a graphite property located in Quebec. Beyond its resource holdings, Volt Carbon also commits to scientific investigation and technological innovation, particularly concerning air classification systems and advancements in battery technology. Incorporated in 1997 and based in Calgary, Canada, the firm was previously known as Saint Jean Carbon Inc. before adopting its current name in February 2022.
